metadata.title: Interview Prep — AlgoCoach
metadata.description: Prepare for technical interviews with guided hints, real code execution, and independent assessments—not just more grinding.

hero.title: An algorithm coach built for technical interviews
hero.description: Focus on common patterns and timed explanations. Build a steady interview prep rhythm across guided hints, real execution feedback, and independent checks.

image_invert.alt: Interview prep workspace in dark mode

introduce.title: Interview prep is more than problem count
introduce.description: AlgoCoach helps you form approaches under time pressure, explain trade-offs, and recover quickly from failing tests.

items.title: Pattern-focused practice
items.description: Train by arrays, linked lists, trees, DP, and other recurring interview patterns.

items.title: Timed independent checks
items.description: Turn off AI assistance and measure accuracy and efficiency on fixed problems.

items.title: Evidence-based diagnosis
items.description: Find root causes from test output and runtime evidence instead of full-answer dumps.

items.title: Weak-pattern review
items.description: Mistakes and hint usage become review cards that return at the right time.

benefits.title: What you get beyond a problem bank
benefits.description: Interview prep needs a clear next step, not just another queue of problems.

items.title: Progressive hints preserve thinking
items.description: Move from concepts to direction to pseudocode without leaking the full solution.

items.title: Real execution in the browser
items.description: Run JavaScript or Python instantly and inspect test feedback.

items.title: Start as a guest
items.description: Try the full flow without registering, then sign in to sync progress.

features.title: Interview prep features
features.description: From the first guided problem to checkpoint reassessments, build a trackable prep path.

items.title: Goal-based onboarding
items.description: Choose interview prep and the daily plan aligns with that goal.

items.title: Baseline check
items.description: An 8-minute no-AI baseline helps the plan start from evidence.

items.title: Checkpoint reassessment
items.description: Compare accuracy and average time after two weeks of practice.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.description: Common questions about using AlgoCoach for interview prep.

items.question: Do I need to sign in first?
items.answer: No. Guest mode covers the full practice flow; sign in later to sync progress.

items.question: Will AI give me the full answer?
items.answer: No. Hints escalate gradually and diagnoses stay tied to execution evidence.

items.question: Which languages are supported?
items.answer: Practice supports JavaScript and Python with in-browser execution.

cta.title: Start interview prep with one guided problem
cta.description: No sign-in required. Experience hints, execution, and test feedback immediately.
